name: Vortex Warp
description: Rankine vortex warp: solid-body rotation inside the core radius and free-vortex circulation (omega ~ 1/r^2) outside it, giving a tightly spun core with a slower, longer-reaching outer flow instead of a rigidly rotating disc. The vortex eye is spring-damped through extraBuffer[133..136] and its own velocity shears the flow, so whipping the cursor drags the vortex behind the pointer. Retains the FFT-banded azimuthal turbulence and flow-aligned angular dispersion from Batch 56.

updatedParams.name: Vortex Strength
updatedParams.description: Circulation gain of the Rankine profile; bass adds up to +45%.

updatedParams.name: Radius
updatedParams.description: Vortex extent; also sets the solid-body core radius.

updatedParams.name: Spiral Twist
updatedParams.description: Radius-dependent spiral layered on the circulation.

updatedParams.name: Turbulence
updatedParams.description: Gain on the FFT-banded azimuthal lobes.
